run_denoise_sample: run the diffusion model denoising pipeline to generate novel views from input images and camera poses
run_encode_image: encode images into VAE latent space with chunked processing for memory efficiency
run_decode_image: decode VAE latents back to pixel space images with optional clamping and chunked processing
run_get_input: build the concatenated input tensor for the diffusion model from images, rays, and masks
run_optimizer_step: execute a training optimizer step with gradient clipping and mixed precision support
